India Dominates Pakistan in Women's Asia Cup Cricket Match

In the Women's Asia Cup, the Indian cricket team decisively defeated Pakistan. Pakistan was bowled out for a total of 55 runs. Indian bowlers Prema and Charani were highlighted for their performance in skittling out the Pakistani team. The match took place in Dubai.
